name: Salicylmethylecgonine
summary: Salicylmethylecgonine, (2′-Hydroxycocaine) is a tropane derivative drug which is both a synthetic analogue and a possible active metabolite of cocaine.

pharmacology.text: Salicylmethylecgonine, (2′-Hydroxycocaine) is a tropane derivative drug which is both a synthetic analogue and a possible active metabolite of cocaine. The hydroxy branch renders the molecule a QSAR of a 10-fold increase over cocaine in its binding potency for the dopamine transporter & a 52-fold enhanced affinity for the norepinephrine transporter.

summaryZh: 2'-羥基古柯鹼是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C17H21NO5，屬於莨菪烷衍生物，古柯鹼的類似物，也是其可能的活性代謝產物。
summaryZhHans: 2'-羟基可卡因是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C17H21NO5，属于莨菪烷衍生物，可卡因的类似物，也是其可能的活性代谢产物。

uses.en: It is a research compound studied as a possible active breakdown product of cocaine. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，被研究作為古柯鹼可能的活性分解產物，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，被研究作为古柯碱可能的活性分解产物，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Cocaine-like stimulants can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, anxiety, overheating and seizures, and carry a risk of heart attack and stroke.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。類似古柯鹼的興奮劑可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、焦慮、體溫過高和癲癇發作，並有心臟病發作和中風的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。类似古柯碱的兴奋剂可能引起心跳过快、高血压、焦虑、体温过高和癫痫发作，并有心脏病发作和中风的风险。

fact.en: It is cocaine with an extra hydroxy group on the ring, in the position that makes it a salicylate, the same pattern found in aspirin's parent acid.
fact.zh: 它是在古柯鹼的環上多加一個羥基，位置剛好使它成為水楊酸酯，和阿斯匹靈母體酸的結構型式相同。
fact.zhHans: 它是在古柯碱的环上多加一个羟基，位置刚好使它成为水杨酸酯，和阿斯匹灵母体酸的结构型式相同。
